claimed_invariant: A relationship center label's preferred dimensions, painted run positions, and painted bounds are projections of one Creole line layout. Java Sea places each atom at `-atomHeight + FontPosition.getSpace()`, takes the minimum as the line top, and derives each atom baseline from that common top plus its own ascent. Subscript and superscript alter only their own reduced-size atoms by +3 and -6 respectively; they do not translate the base-font runs or the whole line. SvekEdge supplies the resulting natural block to Graphviz and paints that same block from the solved top-left.
causal_divergence: Rust's relationship paint path uses label_ascent_with_family, which adds three pixels to the shared baseline whenever any subscript is present. Every run therefore moves down by exactly three pixels even though widths, run-relative sub/sup offsets, and Graphviz placement agree. The code already contains a closer Java Sea projection in label_first_baseline_ascent_with_family, but measurement, emission, and painted-frontier calculations do not consume a single shared line-layout result. The preserved checker_07 counterexample exposes this fault together with a separate link-note font-context fault; each must be repaired and checked independently.
planned_model_change: Represent a Creole line layout explicitly, including natural width and height, the first/base baseline, per-run baselines, and painted bounds. Derive those fields from Java Sea's atom-top formula and FontPosition size/space semantics. Make relationship preferred dimensions, SVG run emission, and painted-frontier projection consume that same result. Do not compensate with a literal negative-three offset and do not alter Graphviz coordinates or route geometry.
perturbation_axes: subscript only, superscript only, and both in one relationship label
large or base-size run before versus after the positioned run
sans-serif versus Arial inherited arrow font
label-only versus label composed with a link note
renamed entities and labels with different glyph widths
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns Creole atom vertical alignment and the consistency of relationship-label dimensions, painting, and painted bounds. It does not own link-note style inheritance, link-note grammar or position, route synthesis, entity dimensions, comparator behavior, baselines, or fixture eligibility.
acceptance: Fresh valid labels prove subscript and superscript move only their own atoms while base runs retain Java baselines.
The same line-layout result drives Graphviz dimensions, SVG emission, and painted-frontier calculation.
Plain-text and no-label controls retain their existing exact output.
An independent checker audits the Java and Rust data flow, generates held-outs over at least two axes, and records a verdict at the exact implementation revision.
forbidden_approaches: subtracting three pixels from labels that contain a subscript
keying behavior to checker_07 text, fixture names, coordinates, or branch counts
changing route geometry, comparator tolerance, baselines, skips, or fixture eligibility
